question: What future divine sport is promised to occur in the city of Keśī?
premises: Vṛndā will manifest in the city
The location is associated with Keśī
A sport involving the devotee is foretold
inference: In the city of Keśī, divine sport with her will certainly take place for the devotee.
plain_english: Certainly, in the city of Keśī, there will be sport with her for you.
